attributes.residual: NONE. The whole residual was 8 differing words forming one symmetric two-web crossing: the loop-count web fed by the SDA21 global re-read is r4 in retail and r5 in ours (+0x6c subf, +0x70 and +0xac cmpw, +0xec lwz, +0xf0 cmpwi), while the anonymous scaled-base temp for the pool element address is r5 in retail and r4 in ours (+0x80 add, +0x84 lwz, +0x88 addi). Both webs are volatile with disjoint live ranges. LESSON: a symmetric crossing in which BOTH halves are named by the same source statement pair is the cleanest webfrank shape there is - the masked scan and the bisimulation agree immediately, and no permutation machinery is needed.
